paragraphs.text:
You climb aboard the canoe and set out downriver. At your next 
rest spot, fish and game abound. A good meal does wonders to 
restore you. At last, you come to the treacherous segment of the 
river that Charlie Foxtail called “the place of splitting water.”
Make a Pilot (Boat) roll: if you succeed, go to 513; if you fail, go to 514.
